articles.title: Letter: Thanks to St. Brendan’s Parish
body: To the editor: I have lived on Vernon Street for 6 years, and I want to say what a difference St. Brendan’s Parish has made.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the September meeting. Please keep the stormwater drain repair in the budget. Many of us on Vernon Street use it every week.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Dominic Ingersoll, Tannery Flats
